server_info.name: weftly
server_info.description: AI post-production: transcribe and summarize audio/video, find compelling clips, cut horizontal or 9:16 vertical clips, and publish to YouTube. Tools: transcribe, summarize, find_clips, extract_clip, extract_vertical_clip, complete_upload, get_job_status, publish_to_youtube, trigger_youtube_publish, get_youtube_publish_status, mpp_smoke_test. Flat per-job pricing, paid inline — by credit card (open the Stripe Checkout link in any browser) or USDC on Tempo via mppx. No subscription, no crypto wallet required.

findings.name: No authentication on remote MCP server
findings.evidence:
https://api.weftly.ai/mcp -> HTTP 200
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"c5f40eb6-de82-49ca-9c17-5c0627493719","result":{"tools":[{"name":"transcribe","description":"Transcribe audio or video to text, including per-word timestamps for precise editing. Three-call flow: (1) call with `filename` to receive {job_id, payment_challenge}; (2) pay via MPP, then call with `job_id` + `payment_credential` to receive {upload_url} (presigned PUT, 1h expiry);
findings.spec_reference: Transports §Security: servers SHOULD authenticate all connections. A protected server MUST answer 401 when authorization is required.
findings.notes: tools/list returned 11 tool(s) without any credential.

findings.name: Cleartext HTTP transport (no TLS)
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §1.5 / MCP Authorization: auth-bearing traffic MUST use HTTPS (loopback exempt).

findings.name: 401 without RFC 9728 WWW-Authenticate pointer
findings.evidence:
https://api.weftly.ai/mcp -> HTTP 200
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"49d1d8ff-ff95-40f2-8981-045aff4245df","result":{"tools":[{"name":"transcribe","description":"Transcribe audio or video to text, including per-word timestamps for precise editing. Three-call flow: (1) call with `filename` to receive {job_id, payment_challenge}; (2) pay via MPP, then call with `job_id` + `payment_credential` to receive {upload_url} (presigned PUT, 1h expiry);
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: on 401 the server MUST return WWW-Authenticate indicating the protected-resource-metadata URL (RFC 9728 §5.1).
findings.notes: Server did not issue a 401/403, so the WWW-Authenticate MUST is not triggered (see no-authentication-remote for the real risk).

findings.name: Missing OAuth Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728)
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: servers MUST expose RFC 9728 metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource including authorization_servers.

findings.name: Session identifier carried in URL/query string
findings.evidence:
https://api.weftly.ai/mcp -> HTTP 200
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"5b3b76dc-f9c2-429a-b8d3-d9b3007f7da0","result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{"tools":{"listChanged":false},"resources":{"listChanged":false,"subscribe":false},"extensions":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/ui":{"mimeTypes":["text/html;profile=mcp-app"]}}},"serverInfo":{"name":"weftly","version":"0.24.1","description":"AI post-production: transcribe and summarize au
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §5: tokens MUST NOT appear in URI query. MCP Streamable HTTP moved the session to the Mcp-Session-Id header.
findings.notes: No header session id and no URL-borne session id observed.
